summary: Append one JSONL line per billed Exa response (costDollars.total + requestId) to the data-dir cost journal so the novel spend command can aggregate per-day, per-resource spend.
reason: The HTTP client is the single choke point for every live Exa call; recording cost there is the only way spend sees all billed traffic, not just novel-command traffic.
validated_outcome: Live answer call journaled; spend --json reports /bin/zsh.0050 with correct day/resource grouping.
